pages.title: Ancient Bison
pages.text: The ancient bison ($(o)Bison antiquus$()) roamed the grasslands and open woodlands of North America, from Canada to Central America, during the Late Pleistocene.$(br2)It was larger and longer-legged than the living American bison, with bigger, straighter horns that spanned about 90 centimetres.$(br2)Clovis and Folsom hunters trapped whole herds in steep-sided gullies. Around 10,000 years ago it gave rise to the modern American bison.
